messages.subject: Spectronaut Data
parts:
Hi, 

I have been trying to run my data through MSstatsShiny, but whenever I do the site crashes on me. How can I get this to work? 

Thank you,
Gabrielle

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: Spectronaut Data
parts:
Hi,


it is likely due to data size.
Can you run MSstats locally?
Would https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acs.jproteome.2c00834 or resources listed here https://msstats.org/get-started/ be enough to help you with running MSstats this way?

Kind regards,
Mateusz

Kind regards,
Mateusz
